subject: POC debrief: HelioPay latency & cost gains — quick advocacy sync
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sarah Cho <sarah@heliopay.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC debrief: HelioPay latency & cost gains — quick advocacy sync

Hi Sarah —

Great to close out the two-week POC yesterday. Really appreciated how quickly your team iterated on integration. Attached is a one-page summary (PII-scrubbed) and the dashboard snapshot showing the end-to-end latency distribution by route. High level results: 

- 92% reduction in tail latency for tokenized payment flows (p99 down from ~1.8s to ~0.15s)
- Average per-request token cost lowered ~37% using prefix caching + batching heuristics
- Throughput sustained at 120 reqs/min on our dedicated 2-GPU profile with headroom for burst

Files attached: heliopay_poc_summary_v1.pdf (one-pager), heliopay_latency_dashboard.png (screenshot), heliopay_metrics_export.csv (timing & cost export).

If these numbers look right on your side, would you be open to: 
1) a 10–15 minute recorded quote (one-liner) we can publish, OR
2) a 15-minute call this week to capture a short quote and confirm attribution?

We try to keep quotes concise and give full approval before publishing — nothing goes live without your sign-off. Proposed times: Wed 09/22 10:30–10:45 PT, Thu 09/23 09:00–09:15 PT, Thu 09/23 14:00–14:15 PT. If those don't work, tell me what does and I'll coordinate.

Thanks again — this POC was a great collaboration.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
